Time',3225,-420,-480),(N'Yukon Standard Time',3379,-480,-420),(N'Yukon Standard Time',3589,-420,-480)) v(zone_name,day_index,previous_offset,next_offset)), hours AS (SELECT c.*,g.value AS hour_index,DATEADD(hour,CONVERT(int,g.value),DATEADD(day,c.day_index-1,CAST('1890-01-01T00:00:00+00:00' AS DATETIMEOFFSET(7)))) AS utc_instant FROM changes c CROSS JOIN GENERATE_SERIES(0,24) g), observed AS (SELECT h.*,DATEPART(TZOFFSET,h.utc_instant AT TIME ZONE h.zone_name) AS observed_offset FROM hours h), first_change AS (SELECT zone_name,day_index,MIN(hour_index) AS hour_index FROM observed WHERE observed_offset=next_offset GROUP BY zone_name,day_index) SELECT c.zone_name,c.day_index,f.hour_index,c.previous_offset,c.next_offset,DATEADD(hour,CONVERT(int,f.hour_index),DATEADD(day,c.day_index-1,CAST('1890-01-01T00:00:00+00:00' AS DATETIMEOFFSET(7)))) AS utc_changed_hour,DATEPART(TZOFFSET,DATEADD(hour,CONVERT(int,f.hour_index)-1,DATEADD(day,c.day_index-1,CAST('1890-01-01T00:00:00+00:00' AS DATETIMEOFFSET(7)))) AT TIME ZONE c.zone_name) AS before_actual,DATEPART(TZOFFSET,DATEADD(hour,CONVERT(int,f.hour_index),DATEADD(day,c.day_index-1,CAST('1890-01-01T00:00:00+00:00' AS DATETIMEOFFSET(7)))) AT TIME ZONE c.zone_name) AS after_actual FROM changes c JOIN first_change f ON f.zone_name=c.zone_name AND f.day_index=c.day_index ORDER BY c.zone_name,c.day_index

Time',3379,10,-480,-420),(N'Yukon Standard Time',3589,9,-420,-480)) v(zone_name,day_index,hour_index,previous_offset,next_offset)), minutes AS (SELECT c.*,g.value AS minute_index,DATEADD(minute,CONVERT(int,g.value),DATEADD(hour,-1,DATEADD(hour,c.hour_index,DATEADD(day,c.day_index-1,CAST('1890-01-01T00:00:00+00:00' AS DATETIMEOFFSET(7)))))) AS utc_instant FROM changes c CROSS JOIN GENERATE_SERIES(0,60) g), observed AS (SELECT m.*,DATEPART(TZOFFSET,m.utc_instant AT TIME ZONE m.zone_name) AS observed_offset FROM minutes m), first_change AS (SELECT zone_name,day_index,MIN(minute_index) AS minute_index FROM observed WHERE observed_offset=next_offset GROUP BY zone_name,day_index) SELECT c.zone_name,c.day_index,c.hour_index,f.minute_index,selected.utc_instant AS utc_transition,c.previous_offset,c.next_offset,CONVERT(VARCHAR(40),DATEADD(minute,-1,selected.utc_instant) AT TIME ZONE c.zone_name) AS before_rendered,DATEPART(TZOFFSET,DATEADD(minute,-1,selected.utc_instant) AT TIME ZONE c.zone_name) AS before_actual,CONVERT(VARCHAR(40),selected.utc_instant AT TIME ZONE c.zone_name) AS after_rendered,DATEPART(TZOFFSET,selected.utc_instant AT TIME ZONE c.zone_name) AS after_actual FROM changes c JOIN first_change f ON f.zone_name=c.zone_name AND f.day_index=c.day_index JOIN minutes selected ON selected.zone_name=c.zone_name AND selected.day_index=c.day_index AND selected.minute_index=f.minute_index AND selected.hour_index=c.hour_index ORDER BY c.zone_name,c.day_index
